This is a simple script to download the latest KEYDB.cfg file for use with AACS to watch BluRay disks.

#!/bin/bash

TMP=/tmp/KEYDB.cfg
FILE=$HOME/.config/aacs/KEYDB.cfg
echo "Downloading KEYDB.cfg"
wget -q -O $TMP http://www.labdv.com/aacs/KEYDB.cfg

NEWDATE=$(sed -n '2{p;q;}' $TMP | awk '{print $2}')
OLDDATE=$(sed -n '2{p;q;}' $FILE | awk '{print $2}')

NEW=$(sed -n '2{p;q;}' $TMP | awk '{print $2}' | sed 's/-//g')
OLD=$(sed -n '2{p;q;}' $FILE | awk '{print $2}' | sed 's/-//g')

if [ "$NEW" -gt "$OLD" ]; then
 echo "The current file is dated $OLDDATE"
 echo "The latest file is dated $NEWDATE"
 echo 
 echo "Do you want to update? y/n"
 read ANSWER
 if [ $ANSWER == "y" ]; then
 mv $TMP $FILE
 echo "Done"
 else
 echo "Clean up"
 rm $TMP
 exit;
 fi
else
 echo "KEYDB is up to date"
fi
